__prompts__.repo_name: Directory / repo name (derived from project_name; [A-Za-z0-9_-] only)
__prompts__.min_snakemake_version: Minimum Snakemake version (must be 8.x -- the SLURM executor plugin requires >=8)
__prompts__.genome_prefix: Shared reference-genome root (becomes the genome_prefix key in code/config/config.yaml)
__prompts__.scratch_dir: Scratch root for large intermediates (becomes the scratch_dir key in code/config/config.yaml)
__prompts__.use_quarto_site: Generate a Quarto site in analysis/ that indexes SUMMARY.md files? (n = Snakemake-only project)
__prompts__.make_conda_env: Create the driver conda env from code/envs/<repo_name>.yaml now? (slow: full solve)
__prompts__.submodules: Snakemake submodules as a JSON dict of {name: {url, branch}}. Names must match [A-Za-z0-9_]. Example: {"rna_seq": {"url": "git@github.com:bfairkun/snakemake-workflow_rna-seq.git", "branch": "main"}}. Press Enter for none.
